title: Moody's Affirms Top AAA.mx Credit Rating for Nuevo Laredo, Citing Healthy Finances and Low Debt

content:
Moody's Local Mexico has affirmed the highest national-scale credit rating — AAA.mx with a stable outlook — for the municipal government of Nuevo Laredo, led by Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal, recognizing the strength of its public finances, its ability to pay, and its low level of debt.

According to the evaluation for November 2026, the city maintains a solid liquidity position, operating and financial surpluses, and a diversified economy driven mainly by international trade with the United States.

One of the most notable achievements of the administration was the early payoff, during 2026, of 580 million pesos in inherited bank debt, which reduced the city government's financial obligations.

According to the indicators in the Moody's evaluation, during 2025 Nuevo Laredo recorded an operating surplus equal to 35.8 percent of its operating income, as well as a financial surplus of 3.3 percent of its total income, even with more resources directed to public investment.

The rating agency also estimates that during 2026 and 2027, net direct and indirect debt will average just 1.1 percent of operating income, while the municipal government does not plan to take on new financing.

Since 2025, Nuevo Laredo has also held the top Triple A rating from Fitch Ratings, in addition to the AAA.mx category from Moody's Local Mexico.

Source: CML Noticias, Nov. 23, 2026.
